verses.sloka: विलपन्तीम् तथा ताम् तु कौसल्याम् प्रमद उत्तमाम् ।इदम् धर्मे स्थिता धर्म्यम् सुमित्रा वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-४४-१॥
verses.transliteration: vilapantīm tathā tām tu kausalyām pramada uttamām ।idam dharme sthitā dharmyam sumitrā vākyam abravīt ॥2-44-1॥

translations.english: While Kausalya, the best of women was thus lamenting, virtuous Sumitra spoke to her these righteous words:
translations.hindi: बनबास के लिए जाते हुए महात्मा एवं सत्यपराक्रमी श्रीरामः चन्द्र जी के पीछे लगे हुए पुरवासी उनमें अनुरक्त हो गए

verses.sloka: तव आर्ये सद् गुणैः युक्तः पुत्रः स पुरुष उत्तमः ।किम् ते विलपितेन एवम् कृपणम् रुदितेन वा ॥२-४४-२॥
verses.transliteration: tava ārye sad guṇaiḥ yuktaḥ putraḥ sa puruṣa uttamaḥ ।kim te vilapitena evam kṛpaṇam ruditena vā ॥2-44-2॥

translations.english: My venerable lady, your son Rama is the greatest among men and is endowed with every virtue. Why do you lament in this way? Why do you weep bitterly?
translations.hindi: यद्यपि महाराज दशरथ और उनके सुहृद्वगे, (जिसको शीघ्र बुलाना हो उसके पीछे दूर तक न जाय- मंत्रियों के मुख से यह सुन कर ) लौट आए थे, तथापि जो पुरवासी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के रथ के पीछे-पीळे जा रहे थे, वे नहीं लौटे

verses.sloka: यः तव आर्ये गतः पुत्रः त्यक्त्वा राज्यम् महा बलः ।साधु कुर्वन् महात्मानम् पितरम् सत्य वादिनाम् ॥२-४४-३॥
verses.transliteration: yaḥ tava ārye gataḥ putraḥ tyaktvā rājyam mahā balaḥ ।sādhu kurvan mahātmānam pitaram satya vādinām ॥2-44-3॥

translations.english: In order to vindicate the words of his great and truthful father, O noble lady,your mighty son has renounced the kingdom and has gone (to the forest). He has stuck to the path so scrupulously followed by the wise, the everlasting results of which can be fully realised in the world to come. Such a peerless son is never to be grieved over.

verses.sloka: शिष्टैः आचरिते सम्यक् शश्वत् प्रेत्य फल उदये ।रामः धर्मे स्थितः श्रेष्ठो न स शोच्यः कदाचन ॥२-४४-४॥
verses.transliteration: śiṣṭaiḥ ācarite samyak śaśvat pretya phala udaye ।rāmaḥ dharme sthitaḥ śreṣṭho na sa śocyaḥ kadācana ॥2-44-4॥

translations.english: In order to vindicate the words of his great and truthful father, O noble lady,your mighty son has renounced the kingdom and has gone (to the forest). He has stuck to the path so scrupulously followed by the wise, the everlasting results of which can be fully realised in the world to come. Such a peerless son is never to be grieved over.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि महायशस्त्री अयोध्याबासी समस्त जनों को गुणवान श्रीरामचन्द्र पूर्ण मासी के चन्द्रमा के समान प्यारे थे ॥३. स याच्यमानः काङुत्स्थः स्वाभिः प्रकृतिभिस्तदा | कुर्वाणः पितरं सत्यं वनमेवान्वपद्यत

verses.sloka: वर्तते च उत्तमाम् वृत्तिम् लक्ष्मणो अस्मिन् सदा अनघः ।दयावान् सर्व भूतेषु लाभः तस्य महात्मनः ॥२-४४-५॥
verses.transliteration: vartate ca uttamām vṛttim lakṣmaṇo asmin sadā anaghaḥ ।dayāvān sarva bhūteṣu lābhaḥ tasya mahātmanaḥ ॥2-44-5॥

translations.english: Blameless Lakshmana, compassionate to all beings, has acted most nobly in this matter for the benefit of his great soul.

verses.sloka: अरण्य वासे यद् दुह्खम् जानती वै सुख उचिता ।अनुगच्चति वैदेही धर्म आत्मानम् तव आत्मजम् ॥२-४४-६॥
verses.transliteration: araṇya vāse yad duhkham jānatī vai sukha ucitā ।anugaccati vaidehī dharma ātmānam tava ātmajam ॥2-44-6॥

translations.english: The daughter of Videha (Sita) who was used to comforts has knowingly followed your virtuous son into the hardships of forest life.
translations.hindi: है अयोध्याबासियो ! तुम लोगों की जैसी प्रीति मुझमें है ओर जैपा आदर तुम लोग मेरा करते हो, मेरी प्रसन्नता के लिए, इससे भी अधिक प्रीति ओर आदर तुम लोग भरत के प्रति प्रदर्शित करना

verses.sloka: कीर्ति भूताम् पताकाम् यो लोके भ्रामयति प्रभुः ।दम सत्य व्रत परः किम् न प्राप्तः तव आत्मजः ॥२-४४-७॥
verses.transliteration: kīrti bhūtām patākām yo loke bhrāmayati prabhuḥ ।dama satya vrata paraḥ kim na prāptaḥ tava ātmajaḥ ॥2-44-7॥

translations.english: Your allcompetent son who considers righteousness and truth as wealth, is waving the flag of fame in this world. What is that which your son did not gain ?
translations.hindi: कैकेयीनन्दून भरत जी चरित्रवान्‌ हैं, वे अवश्य ही तम्हारे लिए यथोचित हितकर ओर प्रिय कार्य करगे

verses.sloka: व्यक्तम् रामस्य विज्ञाय शौचम् माहात्म्यम् उत्तमम् ।न गात्रम् अम्शुभिः सूर्यः सम्तापयितुम् अर्हति ॥२-४४-८॥
verses.transliteration: vyaktam rāmasya vijñāya śaucam māhātmyam uttamam ।na gātram amśubhiḥ sūryaḥ samtāpayitum arhati ॥2-44-8॥

translations.english: Knowing Rama's sterling purity and greatness the Sun evidently dare not scorch his body with its rays.

verses.sloka: शिवः सर्वेषु कालेषु काननेभ्यो विनिह्सृतः ।राघवम् युक्त शीत उष्णः सेविष्यति सुखो अनिलः ॥२-४४-९॥
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ sarveṣu kāleṣu kānanebhyo vinihsṛtaḥ ।rāghavam yukta śīta uṣṇaḥ seviṣyati sukho anilaḥ ॥2-44-9॥

translations.english: A pleasant yet moderately hot and cold breeze blowing through the woodlands will serve Rama at all seasons.
translations.hindi: जञानटृद्धो वयोबालो महुवीयगुजान्वितः अनुरूपः स वो भता भविष्यति भयापहः ॥८]] भरत जी अबस्था में छोटे होने पर भी बड़े ज्ञानबान हें । वे बड़े कोमल चित्त के हें, साथ ही बड़े पराक्रमी भी ८ इनके अतिरिक्त उनमें बात्सल्यादि ओर भी अनेक सद्गुण हें । घे प्रक्र से योग्य हैं । उनके राजा होने पर तुम्हें किसी बात का .... खटका नहीं रहेगा ॥८) ०४) PM ) i. verses.sloka: शयानम् अनघम् रात्रौ पिता इव अभिपरिष्वजन् ।रश्मिभिः सम्स्पृशन् शीतैः चन्द्रमा ह्लादयिष्यति ॥२-४४-१०॥
verses.transliteration: śayānam anagham rātrau pitā iva abhipariṣvajan ।raśmibhiḥ samspṛśan śītaiḥ candramā hlādayiṣyati ॥2-44-10॥

translations.english: While that sinless Rama sleeps at night, the Moon will comfort him by touching him with cool beams like a father embracing his son.
translations.hindi: मेरे बन जाने पर मेरी प्रसन्नता केलिए तुम लोगों को बह काम करना चाहिए, जिससे महाराज को कष्ट न हो अथवा यदि तुम मेरे प्रिय बनना चाहो, तो ऐसा करना जिससे मेरी अनुप- स्थिति में महाराज को कष्ट न हो

verses.sloka: ददौ च अस्त्राणि दिव्यानि यस्मै ब्रह्मा महा ओजसे ।दानव इन्द्रम् हतम् दृष्ट्वा तिमि ध्वज सुतम् रणे ॥२-४४-११॥
verses.transliteration: dadau ca astrāṇi divyāni yasmai brahmā mahā ojase ।dānava indram hatam dṛṣṭvā timi dhvaja sutam raṇe ॥2-44-11॥

translations.english: To the mighty, heroic Rama, that best of men, Brahmalike Viswamitra has bequeathed many divine weapons, seeing him slay Timidhwaja's son (Subahu), lord of demons, in the battle. He will stay fearless in the forest, relying on the strength of his own arms as though he were living in the palace.

verses.sloka: स शूरः पुरुषव्याघ्रः स्वबाहुबलमाश्रितः ।असन्त्रस्तोऽ प्यरण्यस्थो वेश्मनीव निवत्स्यति ॥२-४४-१२॥
verses.transliteration: sa śūraḥ puruṣavyāghraḥ svabāhubalamāśritaḥ ।asantrasto' pyaraṇyastho veśmanīva nivatsyati ॥2-44-12॥

translations.english: To the mighty, heroic Rama, that best of men, Brahmalike Viswamitra has bequeathed many divine weapons, seeing him slay Timidhwaja's son (Subahu), lord of demons, in the battle. He will stay fearless in the forest, relying on the strength of his own arms as though he were living in the palace.

verses.sloka: यस्येषुपदमासाद्य विनाशम् यान्ति शत्रवः ।कथम् न प्R^थिवी तस्य शासने स्थातुमर्हति ॥२-४४-१३॥
verses.transliteration: yasyeṣupadamāsādya vināśam yānti śatravaḥ ।katham na pR^thivī tasya śāsane sthātumarhati ॥2-44-13॥

translations.english: When enemies who are targets of his arrows are destoyed, how can this earth, not stay under the command of Rama?

verses.sloka: या श्रीःशौर्यम् च रामस्य या च कल्याणसत्वता ।निवृत्तारण्यवासः स्वं क्षिप्रम् राज्यमवाप्स्यति ॥२-४४-१४॥
verses.transliteration: yā śrīḥśauryam ca rāmasya yā ca kalyāṇasatvatā ।nivṛttāraṇyavāsaḥ svaṁ kṣipram rājyamavāpsyati ॥2-44-14॥

translations.english: On return from his sojourn in the forest, Rama, endowed with splendour, valour and a strength that brings wellbeing will quickly regain his kingdom.

verses.sloka: सूर्यस्यापि भवेत्सूर्योह्यग्नेरग्निः प्रभोः प्रभोः ।श्रियश्च श्रीर्भवेदग्र्या कीर्त्याः क्षमाक्षमा ॥२-४४-१५॥
verses.transliteration: sūryasyāpi bhavetsūryohyagneragniḥ prabhoḥ prabhoḥ ।śriyaśca śrīrbhavedagryā kīrtyāḥ kṣamākṣamā ॥2-44-15॥

translations.english: O Devi Rama is the Sun (light) of the Sun, fire (splendour) of the fire, master (command) of masters, prosperity of the prosperous, the fame of the famous, forbearance of the forbearing, god of the gods and supreme among all beings. Whether he dwells in the forest or in the city, he has no demerit whatsoever.

verses.sloka: दैवतम् दैवतानाम् च भूतानाम् भूतसत्तमः ।तस्य केह्यगुणा देवि वने वा प्यथवा पुरे ॥२-४४-१६॥
verses.transliteration: daivatam daivatānām ca bhūtānām bhūtasattamaḥ ।tasya kehyaguṇā devi vane vā pyathavā pure ॥2-44-16॥

translations.english: O Devi Rama is the Sun (light) of the Sun, fire (splendour) of the fire, master (command) of masters, prosperity of the prosperous, the fame of the famous, forbearance of the forbearing, god of the gods and supreme among all beings. Whether he dwells in the forest or in the city, he has no demerit whatsoever.

verses.sloka: पृथिव्या सह वैदेह्या श्रिया च पुरुष ऋषभः ।क्षिप्रम् तिसृभिर् एताभिः सह रामः अभिषेक्ष्यते ॥२-४४-१७॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyā saha vaidehyā śriyā ca puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ ।kṣipram tisṛbhir etābhiḥ saha rāmaḥ abhiṣekṣyate ॥2-44-17॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, will soon be coronated with these three namely the earth, the goddess of fortune and Sita.

verses.sloka: दुह्खजम् विसृजन्ति अस्रम् निष्क्रामन्तम् उदीक्ष्य यम् ।समुत्स्रक्ष्यसि नेत्राभ्याम् क्षिप्रम् आनन्दजम् पयः ॥२-४४-१८॥
verses.transliteration: duhkhajam visṛjanti asram niṣkrāmantam udīkṣya yam ।samutsrakṣyasi netrābhyām kṣipram ānandajam payaḥ ॥2-44-18॥

translations.english: When the people of Ayodhya saw the godlike Rama departing, clad in robes of kusha and bark, they were moved to tears of grief. What is impossible for him who is unconquerable and whom Sita, like the goddess of fortune, follows.

verses.sloka: कुशचीरधरम् देवम् गच्छन्तमपराजितम् ।सीतेवानुगता लक्ष्मीस्तस्य किम् नाम दुर्लभम् ॥२-४४-१९॥
verses.transliteration: kuśacīradharam devam gacchantamaparājitam ।sītevānugatā lakṣmīstasya kim nāma durlabham ॥2-44-19॥

translations.english: When the people of Ayodhya saw the godlike Rama departing, clad in robes of kusha and bark, they were moved to tears of grief. What is impossible for him who is unconquerable and whom Sita, like the goddess of fortune, follows.

verses.sloka: धनुर्ग्रहवरो यस्य बाणखड्गास्त्रभृत्स्वयम् ।लक्ष्मणोव्रजति ह्यग्रे तस्य किम् नाम दुर्लभम् ॥२-४४-२०॥
verses.transliteration: dhanurgrahavaro yasya bāṇakhaḍgāstrabhṛtsvayam ।lakṣmaṇovrajati hyagre tasya kim nāma durlabham ॥2-44-20॥

translations.english: What is impossible for Rama ahead of whom moves Lakshmana, the best of archers, weilding swords, arrows and other weapons?

verses.sloka: निवृत्तवनवासम् तम् द्रष्टासि पुनरागतम् ।जहिशोकम् च मोहम् च देवि सत्यम् ब्रवीमि ते ॥२-४४-२१॥
verses.transliteration: nivṛttavanavāsam tam draṣṭāsi punarāgatam ।jahiśokam ca moham ca devi satyam bravīmi te ॥2-44-21॥

translations.english: I tell you the truth, Kausalya, that you will see Rama's return when the period of exile is complete. Hence give up your sorrow and delusion.

verses.sloka: शिरसा चरणावेतौ वन्दमानमनिन्दिते ।पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि कल्याणि! पुत्रं चन्द्रमिवोदितम् ॥२-४४-२२॥
verses.transliteration: śirasā caraṇāvetau vandamānamanindite ।punardrakṣyasi kalyāṇi! putraṁ candramivoditam ॥2-44-22॥

translations.english: O irreproachable and auspicious one you will see your son, like the rising Moon, touching your feet with his head.

verses.sloka: पुनः प्रविष्टम् द्R^ष्ट्वा तमभिषिक्तम् महाश्रियम् ।समुत्स्रक्ष्यसि नेत्राभ्याम् क्षिप्रमान्न्दजम् पयः ॥२-४४-२३॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ praviṣṭam dR^ṣṭvā tamabhiṣiktam mahāśriyam ।samutsrakṣyasi netrābhyām kṣipramānndajam payaḥ ॥2-44-23॥

translations.english: Soon you will see him enthrouned shining in full glory on his return from exile while tears of joy will flow from your eyes.

verses.sloka: मा शोको देवि दुःखम् वा न राअमे दृअह्य्RWऽशिवम् ।क्षिप्रम् द्रक्ष्यसि पुत्रम् त्वम् ससीतम् सह लक्ष्मणम् ॥२-४४-२४॥
verses.transliteration: mā śoko devi duḥkham vā na rāame dṛahyRW'śivam ।kṣipram drakṣyasi putram tvam sasītam saha lakṣmaṇam ॥2-44-24॥

translations.english: Desist from grief or tear for Rama, O Devi nothing inauspicious will happen to him you will soon see your son along with Sita and Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: त्वया शेषोओ जनश्चैव समाश्वास्यो यदाऽनघे ।किमिदानीमिदम् देवि करोषि हृदि विक्लबम् ॥२-४४-२५॥
verses.transliteration: tvayā śeṣoo janaścaiva samāśvāsyo yadā'naghe ।kimidānīmidam devi karoṣi hṛdi viklabam ॥2-44-25॥

translations.english: O sinless lady, O queen when you are overcome by fear, how can you console others?

verses.sloka: नार्हा त्वम् शोचितुम् देवि यस्यास्ते राघवस्सुतः ।न हि रामात्परो लोके विद्यते सत्पथे स्थितः ॥२-४४-२६॥
verses.transliteration: nārhā tvam śocitum devi yasyāste rāghavassutaḥ ।na hi rāmātparo loke vidyate satpathe sthitaḥ ॥2-44-26॥

translations.english: O Kausalya, with a son like Rama, you should not grieve. There is none in this world superior to Rama who stands steady in the path of virtue.

verses.sloka: अभिवादयमानम् तम् दृष्ट्वा ससुहृदम् सुतम् ।मुदा अश्रु मोक्ष्यसे क्षिप्रम् मेघ लेका इव वार्षिकी ॥२-४४-२७॥
verses.transliteration: abhivādayamānam tam dṛṣṭvā sasuhṛdam sutam ।mudā aśru mokṣyase kṣipram megha lekā iva vārṣikī ॥2-44-27॥

translations.english: Like a flake of cloud in monsoon, you are going to shed tears of joy soon seeing your son along with his friends bowing to you in reverence.

verses.sloka: पुत्रः ते वरदः क्षिप्रम् अयोध्याम् पुनर् आगतः ।पाणिभ्याम् मृदुपीनाभ्याम् चरणौ पीडयिष्यति ॥२-४४-२८॥
verses.transliteration: putraḥ te varadaḥ kṣipram ayodhyām punar āgataḥ ।pāṇibhyām mṛdupīnābhyām caraṇau pīḍayiṣyati ॥2-44-28॥

translations.english: Your son, bestower of boons, will soon return to Ayodhya and press your feet with his soft, tender hands.

verses.sloka: अभिवाद्य नमस्यन्तम् शूरम् ससुहृदम् सुतम् ।मुदास्रैः प्रोक्ष्यसि पुनर्मेघराजि रिवाचलम् ॥२-४४-२९॥
verses.transliteration: abhivādya namasyantam śūram sasuhṛdam sutam ।mudāsraiḥ prokṣyasi punarmegharāji rivācalam ॥2-44-29॥

translations.english: While paying obeisance to you, you will drench your brave son, surrounded by friends, with tears of joy like a mass of clouds drenching the mountain.

verses.sloka: आश्वासयन्ती विविधैश्च वाक्यै ।र्वाक्योपचारे कुशलानाद्या ।रामस्य ताम् मातरमेवमुक्त्वा ।देवी सुमित्राविरराम रामा ॥२-४४-३०॥
verses.transliteration: āśvāsayantī vividhaiśca vākyai ।rvākyopacāre kuśalānādyā ।rāmasya tām mātaramevamuktvā ।devī sumitrāvirarāma rāmā ॥2-44-30॥

translations.english: Irreproachable and skilful in the use of words, queen Sumitra of cheerful disposition fell silent after thus consoling Rama's mother in various ways.

verses.sloka: निशम्य तल् लक्ष्मण मातृ वाक्यम् ।रामस्य मातुर् नर देव पत्न्याः ।सद्यः शरीरे विननाश शोकः ।शरद् गतः मेघैव अल्प तोयः ॥२-४४-३१॥
verses.transliteration: niśamya tal lakṣmaṇa mātṛ vākyam ।rāmasya mātur nara deva patnyāḥ ।sadyaḥ śarīre vinanāśa śokaḥ ।śarad gataḥ meghaiva alpa toyaḥ ॥2-44-31॥

translations.english: On hearing the words of Lakshmana's mother the grief in the heart of the queen (Kausalya), mother of Rama, instantly disappeared like the autumnal cloud that holds but little rain. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुश्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfourth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
